Author: Rayla Petal
Name: PoseKit
Description: Animation Assistance Plugin, offset your character's pose, save named presets and replay them, auto-discover Penumbra pose mods, and manually resync emote timing with a partner.
Punchline: Offset, save, and replay poses; auto-discover Penumbra animation mods.
Changelog:
- New layout: Animations and Presets are now tabs at the top, next to the title, and the page gets the full width. Pairing, Live Offset and Bone Align are always shown together in one column on the right.
- Resync and Freecam moved up next to Settings. Freecam turns green while it's on, and its controls show in the status line.
- The color legend now sits on the status line under the title.
- An idle pairing (2 hours with no activity) now ends quietly on each side without sending an unpair tell.
